key_insight: The paper argues that superconducting quantum chip design is reaching a "SPICE moment," requiring a model-driven Quantum EDA framework that unifies physical design, simulation, fabrication, and measurement feedback.
engineering_relevance: It reframes quantum chip development as an engineering stack built from PCells, Quantum PDKs, and co-optimization across layout, process variation, packaging, and cryogenic readout.
method: Define a Quantum Chip Paradigm Framework spanning physical structures to Quantum SoC systems
Use PCell-based modeling and SPICE-Q simulation for reusable chip components
Close the loop with design-technology-measurement co-optimization and fabrication feedback
evidence_signal: The abstract presents a conceptual framework and hierarchical system proposal, but does not report experimental results or quantitative benchmarking.
watch_item: A major implementation challenge is standardizing models and feedback across diverse hardware, fabrication processes, and cryogenic measurement environments.
